'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported…' warning on add-saved-banner animation — web-only cosmetic.

tabBarTestID='tab-profile'/'tab-library'/'tab-home' declared in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx do NOT render as data-testid on RN-Web — tests must fall back to text selectors ('Home'/'Library'/'Profile'). Non-blocking.

action_items: None blocking — client.ts + theme.ts + app.json changes are safe to ship.

(Reminder) The production BASE-fallback branch (client.ts lines 13–17) CANNOT be exercised in preview because __DEV__===true. To verify the prod path, build with `expo export` (or a real prod APK) and confirm: (a) if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is empty OR still contains '.preview.emergentagent.com' → BASE === 'https://media-vault-api.emergent.host'; (b) if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is a distinct prod host → BASE === that host unchanged.

(Minor code-review nit) The hard-coded string 'https://media-vault-api.emergent.host' is now inlined in client.ts. Acceptable as a documented safety net, but consider driving it from a build-time env instead (e.g. EXPO_PUBLIC_PROD_BACKEND_URL) to avoid touching source when the prod host ever changes.
critical_code_review_comments: client.ts BASE derivation is correct and preview-safe: __DEV__ short-circuit means preview always uses RAW_BASE. The two-condition fallback (empty || preview substring) covers both the 'env not injected' and 'env forgot to rewrite' failure modes for a prod build.
The new PROD_BACKEND constant is a hard-coded host — acceptable given deployment realities, but see action_items for a follow-up to source it from env.

theme.ts IMAGES.authHero is loaded via <Image source={{uri: IMAGES.authHero}}> on both login and register screens; the new URL responds 200 and image loads (naturalWidth=853, naturalHeight=1844, complete=true).
app.json android.permissions now includes 'INTERNET' — required for release builds on Android; correct placement inside expo.android.permissions.
